text: For a hundred years, the lighthouse of Greywater never once went dark.
asr: For a hundred years, the lighthouse of gray water never once went dark.
sub: For a hundred years, the lighthouse of Greywater never once went dark.

text: Take the last flame, little Wren. Keep it close. Don't let the wind have it.
asr: Take the last flame, little Ren. Keep it close. Don't let the wind have it.

text: Through the Whisperwood, where even the moon loses its way,
asr: Through the whisper would, where even the moon loses its way,

text: up the Gale Steps, where the storm tried to take it from her.
But a flame held by careful hands does not go out.
And far out at sea, every lost ship found its way home.
Every path begins with a single light.
